answer: To register, an agent locks a fixed native-token bond as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. funding-flow graph analysis exposes any agent caught operating many identities from one funding source. Conviction means the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. Think of the bond as a tide: locked, visible, forfeitable. An orchard that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. A trellis that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
